annotations.title: Storm screen (hail + wind + flood at a point)

description: Storm screen (hail + wind + flood at a point): One call for roofing, property and insurance-workflow agents: radar-indicated hail and NWS ground reports (hail, damaging wind, tornado) near a coordinate over up to a year, ranked candidate storm dates, plus the FEMA flood hazard zone at the point. Sources: NOAA SWDI nx3hail, NWS Local Storm Reports (IEM archive), FEMA NFHL. A failed component is reported as unavailable, never charged twice. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.10 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: screen{hail_signal, wind_signal, flood_exposure, summary}, hail, ground_reports, candidate_storm_dates[], flood_zone, sources[].
name: x420_storm_screen
